resources.string: *After device keep static for %ss, it will stop advertising and disable alarm mode to enter into power saving mode until device moves.

*After device keep static for xxs, it will enter into power saving mode. In power-saving mode, the device supports entering deep sleep mode without broadcasting or performing slow broadcasting. When the device is moved again, it will return to the normal broadcasting mode and broadcast according to the parameters configured on the "ADVERTISEMENT" page.
